title: When the Winter Breaks
author: Sable Okafor
blurb: Jonah Ravensworth, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
